items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had an opportunity to play with her in 2011.

ctx.x: Where did Pearl Bailey come in?
Pearl Bailey was before I left Washington. I had an opportunity to play with her in 2011. You know where that is? That’s on 15th Street. It’s a complex.
It’s above U Street. It’s now a big apartment building, the [Caramel?] Heights thing.
